events.description: Seven nights of 4.5-5.5 h sleep causing cumulative reaction slowing.
Viral-like illness raising resting heart rate by +7 bpm starting 4 days before peak day 66.
High-workload block with two nights under 5 h sleep and slower reactions.
Short sleep under 6 h before days 119 and 120, putting day 119 in watch and day 120 in act.
